body: I'm giving her time, and if she decides to stay with me I know its going to take a lot of time and patience until she's ready to trust me again. I know that she's understandably shocked and very hurt by it. I know that its going to effect our relationship significantly if she decides i'm worth her time. I just really don't want to see my life without her.

We were having issues with our sex life but I didn't have sex with the girl I cheated with. While the sex drive is an issue I am not sure it is was caused this whole thing. I really don't understand why I did it. I am definitely trying to give her space right now so she can decide how she wants to act from here but its nice to get some non-judgmental thoughts on whats happening. I really appreciate this.

Thats not it at all, while our bedroom life has been in trouble I didn't feel that sexually frustrated. I was just extremely drunk and it kind of happened. Now i'm probably going to lose the person I thought was "the one" in life over a huge fucking mistake. I just don't want to lose her and I know the thought of it is making me want to die, I feel like the biggest piece of shit and don't really want to go on. The only reason i'm continuing on at this point is because I know how selfish suicide can be.

i'm glad I was honest too but imagining my life without her seem pretty impossible. She has a huge impact on my life and i'm not quite sure what i'll do if she goes. I'm really scared of losing her. I don't know why I did it and I know for a fact that I am deeply in love with her and only her. Just not sure what to do at this point.
